title: Peanut allergy prevalence among US children

source.name: Addendum Guidelines for the Prevention of Peanut Allergy in the United States
source.publisher: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)

notes: US childhood peanut-allergy prevalence roughly tripled between 1997 and 2008 (0.4% to 1.4%), per the serial cross-sectional prevalence surveys cited in NIAID's 2017 Addendum Guidelines for the Prevention of Peanut Allergy -- the rising-prevalence data that helped motivate the guideline reversal described in leap_study_avoidance_vs_consumption and peanut_allergy_before_after_guidelines.
